answer: An adversary hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 13 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The lagoon counter is kept in island and canyon shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 13 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1230 identities would post 3508 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
